data: Eight robotic vehicle systems including three real vehicles (abstract).
reported_result: Abstract: the control-based techniques were incapable of detecting the stealthy attacks, and the attacks had significant adverse impact on missions (large deviation from the target, or a crash). No rates in the abstract.
relation_to_project: Closest evidence found for notes question 2 in a vehicle setting: a monitor that checks runtime behaviour with control algorithms was evaded by attacks built to stay inside what the monitor accepts, including on real vehicles. The residual-plus-threshold checks of slides 01 to 05 have the same shape, so each needs a stay-under-the-threshold attack test (inference). Sensors and actuators of robotic vehicles, not camera perception.
